title: resolvers
description: Named reads of the trigger kind's context. A data graph or a binding that names this document reads each resolver as {{name}} or {{name.field}}, and the value comes straight from request.* -- nothing runs. This is the one place a feature says what it takes from the request; a domain graph never reads it. Lives in a feature's edge/ directory, since request.* is the world's vocabulary.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/resolvers.schema.json.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

resolvers.description: name -> what it reads. The name is how graphs and bindings refer to the value: {{name}}.

read.description: A path into the request, from the root request: request.params.id, request.body.title, request.headers['user-agent']. A key that is not an identifier is written in brackets and quotes.

label.description: A short human name for this resolver, shown instead of its name.
